title: ロボットプログラミング
subtitle: Robot Programming
educationalGoal: Students will learn the basics of the Python language and Data Structures & Algorithms, as computer programs are essential for developing intelligent robots, and in particular for implementing motion control and environmental information acquisition.
advice: This is a basic course on computer science by the Python language. Students are expected to actively participate in class. Students are expected to complete exercises independently. Students are required to bring their own laptop computers for use in exercises. Students are required to check for messages/materials on the KIT Inside website before every class and be aware of this information during class because the course schedule and content may change depending on the progress of the class.
books: Textbook1: ISBN 978-4130624589 (in Japanese). Textbook2: ISBN 978-4815637217 (in Japanese).
